527:t_027:0.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「The enemy's destruction is confirmed, but neither Miss $$千鳥$$ nor $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$...」

527:t_027:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But we have shown $$アマルガム$$ our resolve. That is enough for now.」

527:t_027:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$アル$$, how many minutes did it take?」

527:t_027:3.en:
$$アル$$
「Unfortunately, over four minutes have elapsed. I judge your declaration to have been a bluff, Sergeant.」

527:t_027:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「That was a figure of speech.」

527:t_027:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Besides, these results are normally inconceivable.」

527:t_027:6.en:
$n
「Don't talk like you did it all yourself.」

527:t_027:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's right. We only managed it because we all worked hard.」

527:t_027:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「But, well... I'm glad you're safe, $$アル$$.」

527:t_027:11.en:
$$アル$$
「Yes, Sergeant. I am glad too.」

527:t_027:12.en:
$$アル$$
「I want you to know that, at least, comes from my heart.」

527:t_027:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Hmph... You talk about your heart, even though you're a machine...」

527:t_027:14.en:
$$宗介$$
(It's like a conversation between comrades in arms, but strangely, it doesn't feel bad...)

527:t_027:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「I've spotted a machine to the north-northeast! It's using $$ＥＣＳ$$ to escape from here!」

527:t_028:0.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...$$宗介$$... Can you hear me...?」

527:t_028:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I am calm! There's no problem!」

527:t_028:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have so much to tell you! Too much has happened to explain it all, but despite my doubts, I came this far!」

527:t_028:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「Is there an enemy beside you?! Then...!」

527:t_028:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't come after me... I'm with $$カリーニン$$ right now. $$レナード$$ is here too.」

527:t_028:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Poor $$レナード$$... Even so, I thought about escaping again and again, but I realized it's impossible.」

527:t_028:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「We can never beat them. The more we resist, the more people get hurt...」

527:t_028:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So I'm sorry. Please don't come after me anymore...」

527:t_028:18.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm really happy you're coming after me. But still...」

527:t_028:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$千鳥$$, what are you saying?」

527:t_028:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So, $$宗介$$... Just... forget about me...」

527:t_028:23.en:
$$宗介$$
(I don't want to understand that...! A world without $$千鳥$$ means nothing to me!)

527:t_028:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$... As the former student council vice president, I'm giving you an order. Okay?」

527:t_028:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't care what you have to sacrifice! Use everything you've got... all those absurd, unbearably troublesome soldier skills of yours that aren't worth shit...」

527:t_028:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Beat the hell out of anyone, no matter how dangerous, and come hold me in your arms!! You can do that, right?!」

527:t_028:33.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll definitely come. Wait for me.」

527:t_028:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「I feel the same. I love you.」

527:t_028:37.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then, next time we really see each other, let's be sure to kiss.」

527:t_028:38.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Let's kiss with everything we've got, wherever we are. Okay? Promise me?」

527:t_028:40.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll wait years, even hundreds of years...」

527:t_028:41.en:
$$宗介$$
「It'll be all right. I'll definitely reach you.」

527:t_030:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That much is easy for me now.」

527:t_030:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just wait, $$ファイヤバグ$$! I'll be the one to finish you off!」

527:t_031:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're pretty good. I can't let you outdo me.」

527:t_031:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Just wait, $$ファイヤバグ$$! I'll be the one to finish you off!」

527:t_032:0.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Heh... It seems my sideburns were wearing away without my noticing...」

527:t_032:1.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Goodbye, life... May the mighty $$ゲイツ$$ live forever...」

527:t_033:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「So that's the end of that pervert...」

527:t_033:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Who knows? Knowing him, we might suddenly run into him again on some battlefield.」

527:t_033:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then I'll just send him back to hell again.」

527:t_033:4.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I-I'm not dying! To hell with sideburns and beards! I'll survive by any means necessary!」

527:t_034:0.en:
$$マオ$$
「So that's the end of that pervert...」

527:t_034:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Who knows? Knowing him, we might suddenly run into him again on some battlefield.」

527:t_034:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then I'll just send him back to hell again.」

527:t_035:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I-I'm not dying! I won't die in a place like this!」

527:t_035:1.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I'll retreat while the $$エクルビス$$ can still move! Remember this, $$キリコ$$! And...!」

527:t_036:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even $$カン・ユー$$ apparently couldn't afford to take his time with parting threats today.」

527:t_036:1.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Even I, an immortal, have to admire his tenacity.」

527:t_036:2.en:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Hahaha, $$カン・ユー$$! That's why you'll never be first-rate!」
